verdict.rationale: Cactus markets an 'Automation Foundation Model' and a fine-tuning platform, so asking about versioning and rollback of automations is fair. However, no evidence shows it lets users version, review, or roll back their automations. The closest item is pinning an older model generation ('generation=2 keeps running Needle 2'). That is model-version selection, an adjacent capability rather than versioning or rollback of user automations, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
